core_obligations: The ringed structure and the adjoint (proof lines 1483-1488): g_n^{-1}O = O_n (from the sets-level lemma) makes g_n a morphism of ringed topoi, and the Modules-on-Sites lemma provides the left adjoint g_{n!} of g_n^*.

The explicit model (lines 1488-1501): H has degree-m component the O_m-module direct sum of f_varphi^*G over varphi : [n] -> [m]; for psi : [m] -> [m'] the transition is given componentwise by f_psi^{-1}f_varphi^*G -> f_psi^*f_varphi^*G -> f_{psi varphi}^*G, which is O(psi)-semi-linear, so H is an O-module by the componentwise description of sheaves on the total site.

The adjunction bijection (lines 1503-1515): Mor_{O_n}(G, F_n) = Mor_O(H, F) proven directly, proceeding as in the proof of the sets-level restriction lemma (see notes); hence H = g_{n!}G and the restriction formula of the statement holds.
proof_roadmap: Promote g_n to a morphism of ringed topoi and cite the existence of the module-level adjoint.
Build H degree by degree with the twisted copies f_varphi^*G and semi-linear transitions.
Check the adjunction bijection following the sets-level template and conclude H = g_{n!}G.
